title: CADETS Act
official_summary:
Changing Age-Determined Eligibility To Student Incentive Payments Act or the CADETS Act

This act modifies the age requirements for the Student Incentive Payment Program, which provides financial support to cadets who attend one of six state maritime academies and commit to a post-graduation service obligation.

Specifically, the act modifies the age requirements to allow older cadets to qualify for the program if they will meet the age requirements for enlistment or commission in the Navy Reserve at the time of their graduation. Current age requirements prohibit cadets older than 25 from participating in the program.

summary.headline: Law lets older students at state maritime academies qualify for a federal student payment program tied to post-graduation service.
summary.what_it_does: The Student Incentive Payment Program gives money to cadets at six state maritime academies who agree to a service obligation after they graduate. Before this law, cadets older than 25 could not join the program. The law changes the age rule so a cadet qualifies if they will meet the Navy Reserve's age limits for enlistment or commission when they graduate.

who_it_affects.group: Cadets over 25 at state maritime academies
who_it_affects.how: They can now qualify for the payments if they will meet Navy Reserve age requirements by graduation.
More of their students may become eligible for federal incentive payments.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted June 30, 2023; the summary does not state a separate effective date.
